objects.count_basis: Source identities; whole-object fallbacks included; cross-source geometry deduplication incomplete.

materials.scope: Current active non-fluid material nodes, including reviewed narrower-material references. No automatic product parameter assignment.

object_priority_coverage.scope: Current object-associated material labels and options; three properties may come from different admitted groups. No new property values or automatic product assignments.

recordedComponentsWithoutReviewedMateria.scope: Recorded inventory components lacking a reviewed nonfluid material identity; may overlap unresolved source-relation tasks, so do not add the two counts.

object_material_index.basis: Current material options plus accepted source relations and reviewed source-scope links; alternatives and coexisting scopes retained; no numerical property assignment.
